summary:
Reviewed 91b7750d, w211's only commit after its last claim (31862091). It matches the implementer's result, and the earlier transport commits are fully reverted.
features/ changes only by retiring @r1/@r3, which the work-item lists. No test is removed or weakened outside that, except a Minor loosening of the shared step 'the upstream keeps one new request' (no longer pins q1; r19 still does). The setup allowance holds.
tools check: ruff clean, vulture 1 issue (unused 'named' in requests_world_steps.py:106, Minor), no import contracts. tools size: clean.
Two Important findings are fix now. (1) gate/outcome decide the side from whether spec/index.md lists any ## Upstreams, so such a repository can no longer raise an internal request with --source or give its own requests line outcomes (contradicts r44, r15, r25). (2) r34 is applied to outcome only: ask, resolve by the asker and reply by the upstream still write the other side's part.
Both hinge on how a side is decided without a transport (w212), so the person may need to rule.
Cannot verify: no plan covers the narrowed build; r25's take-in runs no command.
questions: Important, scripts/workqueue_request.py:99-105,143-145: the side is decided from any ## Upstreams in spec/index.md, so a repository that lists an upstream cannot raise an internal request with --source or give line outcomes to its own requests (contradicts r44, r15, r25).

Important, scripts/workqueue_request.py:152-169 (ask, reply) and resolve: r34's side check is applied to work outcome only; the asker can still write the upstream's questions and resolution, and the upstream the asker's answers.
